evidenceFindings.finding: Equal political liberties, fair opportunities to influence government and constitutional constraints have priority.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified institutional inference follows from political equality, not expertise, class status or unrestricted executive authority.

evidenceFindings.finding: Equal basic liberties include conscience, speech and liberty of the person under the rule of law.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Basic-liberty inference applies to this restriction; specific surveillance, weapons and policing rules are not assumed.

evidenceFindings.finding: Reasonable comprehensive doctrines coexist under one political conception citizens endorse without surrendering nonpublic identities.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Plural civic-membership inference does not automatically establish every cultural subsidy or accommodation.

evidenceFindings.finding: Law of Peoples permits self-defence and intervention against grave human-rights violations; denies wars of national expansion.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified foreign-policy inference preserves humanitarian exceptions and proportionate coercion rather than absolute pacifism.

evidenceFindings.finding: Independent peoples honour treaties and reciprocity; world government risks despotism, with coordinated international organizations allowed.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Question-specific inference distinguishes treaty commitments from unrestricted global government or every court jurisdiction.

evidenceFindings.finding: Either property-owning democracy or liberal socialism can satisfy justice; ownership alone does not choose between these supported alternatives.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Neutral reflects two expressly permitted regimes, not missing evidence; sector-specific ownership is still unresolved.

evidenceFindings.finding: Rejects command socialism; fair opportunity is maintained through legislation governing education, property, hiring and wages.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified institutional-market inference does not treat all redistribution or regulation as compulsory production planning.

evidenceFindings.finding: Guarantees a social minimum and fair opportunity; inequality is permissible when it improves the least advantaged, not merely because equal income is an end.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified justice-based distribution assessment does not presume a particular tax schedule or cash-only implementation.

evidenceFindings.finding: Public justification is political rather than derived from one religious/metaphysical doctrine.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Institutional-secular inference concerns civil authorization of law; personal faith and public ceremony remain separate.

evidenceFindings.finding: Family form need not be monogamous or heterosexual when it performs its duties; wives have equal citizenship and voluntary roles.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified recognition inference retains family responsibilities and avoids imposing a required heterosexual model.

evidenceFindings.finding: Unequal child-care responsibilities create women’s structural disadvantage; families form future citizens’ cooperative virtues.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified causal inference is confined to these actual institutional explanations, not generalized trait heredity.

evidenceFindings.finding: Law of Peoples rejects expansionist force for economic gain while permits self-defense and grave human-rights intervention without a prior attack.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified disagreement distinguishes national expansion/gain from the expressly admitted humanitarian exception. This is not a self-defense-only military doctrine.

evidenceFindings.finding: Public reason assigns public officials and legislators publicly accessible political reasons rather than privileged comprehensive religious authority.
evidenceFindings.rationale: Qualified disagreement concerns an official religion-based institutional review role, including advisory privilege; private religious participation in public debate remains permissible.
